channel.title: Posts on GTA 6 News
channel.description: Recent content in Posts on GTA 6 News

item.title: PS5 Pro is selling out because of GTA 6, and scalpers are already asking up to $1,300 for one
item.description: The surge of interest in GTA 6 after the Extended Look is emptying store shelves of PlayStation 5 Pro units, with resale prices tripling the console's original value.

item.title: GTA 6 pre-orders surge 572% after the Extended Look, and PS5 Pro stock is already gone
item.description: Sensor Tower data confirms GTA 6 pre-orders rose 436% one day after the Extended Look, and 572% cumulative two days later. The impact even hit PS5 Pro stock.

item.title: GTA 6 just broke a Netflix record even Rockstar didn't see coming, and the map's size explains why
item.description: The Extended Look became the number 1 most-watched title on Netflix, beating out movie premieres. It was also confirmed that GTA 6's map will be about three times bigger than Red Dead Redemption 2's.

item.title: Beyond the gameplay: everything Rockstar revealed today about GTA 6 that almost nobody is talking about
item.description: Between the Extended Look and an exclusive interview with Dazed, Rockstar confirmed a real fashion system, in-game streamers, the return of Snapmatic, and even the ability to pet dogs.

item.title: GTA 6's combat looks a lot like Max Payne 3, and that could change the series forever
item.description: We break down why the combat system shown in GTA 6's Extended Look, with tactical slow-motion and more precise shooting, feels so much like Max Payne 3.

item.title: Why GTA 6's Netflix premiere matters more than it seems
item.description: Netflix streamed the new GTA 6 material in a world exclusive, six hours ahead of YouTube. We break down what this partnership means for the future of video games and streaming.

item.title: This is how GTA 6's Extended Look went: Jason, Lucia, and a fight that redefines the series' combat
item.description: Rockstar showed 26 minutes of real GTA 6 gameplay on Netflix. We break down scene by scene what was shown: an apartment building, a guy named Boobie, and a combat system reminiscent of Max Payne 3.

item.title: Rockstar breaks its silence on the GTA 6 leaks: what they said (and what they avoided saying)
item.description: Rockstar issued an unusual statement calling the leaks "heartbreaking." But there is one key question the message leaves unanswered, just a day before the Netflix event.

item.title: New wave of GTA 6 leaks: beach, video game store, and just two days from the official event
item.description: CyberLeek posted three more clips on August 25: Jason biking along the beach, a fictional video game store, and a third video with explicit content that sparked separate controversy.

item.title: CyberLeek's dark side: its cryptocurrency surges while the movement it cited disowns it
item.description: The CYBERLEEK token surged over 14x in 24 hours while Stop Killing Games, the movement the leaker cited as inspiration, publicly distanced itself from their actions.

item.title: Eight GTA 6 leaked videos and counting: CyberLeek claims to have a full playable build
item.description: New leaks show Jason in a strip club and driving at high speed. CyberLeek claims to have a playable build distributed across multiple locations worldwide, though part of this latest claim remains unconfirmed.

item.title: The CyberLeek case escalates: Take-Two subpoenas Microsoft and Discord, and the hacker threatens to leak the full game
item.description: Take-Two filed legal subpoenas against Microsoft and Discord to identify CyberLeek. The group responded by threatening to leak all of GTA 6 if "something happens to them."

item.title: Jason and Lucia: who are the two protagonists of GTA 6
item.description: Full profile of Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, the protagonists of GTA 6: their past, their relationship, and why they break 25 years of series tradition.

item.title: CyberLeek: who is the hacker behind the biggest GTA 6 leak since 2022
item.description: A group calling itself CyberLeek leaked gameplay footage and the full map of GTA 6 days before the official Netflix presentation. Here is what we know.

item.title: GTA 6 is coming only to PS5 and Xbox Series X|S: here is what we know about the PC version
item.description: Rockstar confirmed GTA 6 launches on November 19, 2026 for consoles only. We break down what is known (and what is just a rumor) about the PC version.

item.title: GTA 6 finally has an official release date: November 19, 2026
item.description: Rockstar Games officially confirmed that Grand Theft Auto VI will launch on November 19, 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

item.title: Everything we know about GTA 6 so far (and why it is not just rumors anymore)
item.description: Release date, price, editions, protagonists and map: we cover everything officially confirmed about GTA 6 ahead of launch.
